Title: OpenTofu has high CPU usage when using K8S remote state backend or when parsing specifically crafted TLS certificates from untrusted or compromised servers
Description:
When OpenTofu performs requests against an untrusted (or compromised) third-party server or connects to an attacker-controlled server, the initial connection negotiation can produce high CPU usage, leading to possible denial of service.

These vulnerabilities **do not** permit arbitrary code execution or allow disclosure of confidential information.
AffectedVersions: All versions before 1.11.9, all versions starting from 1.12.0-beta1 before 1.12.2
NotImpacted: All versions starting from 1.11.9 before 1.12.0-beta1, all versions starting from 1.12.2
